items.title: Chew some Bubblegum
items.detail: Open a perk card pack or find Bubblegum at Whitespring Robo Butler Collectron.

items.title: Build a Floor, Wall, or Roof in a Workshop or C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Build a basic wood or concrete floor at your C.A.M.P. and scrap it.

items.title: Collect Purified Water
items.detail: Collect from your C.A.M.P. water purifier or find at Rollins Labor Camp.

items.title: Complete Daily Operations on a Public Team!
items.detail: Join a Daily Ops public team and complete the Daily Operation instance.

items.title: Cripple a Blood Eagle's Arm
items.detail: Fast travel to The Kill Box and use V.A.T.S. to cripple a Blood Eagle's arm.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom
items.detail: Find masked cultists around cabins and campgrounds; listen for child's laughter.

items.title: Kill an Enemy in the Skyline Valley Region
items.detail: Fast travel to Grindstone Arch for a dense Super Mutant group.

items.title: Build a Turret or Trap in a Workshop or C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Place any turret or trap under Defense in build menu; Punji Board costs 4 steel and 8 wood.

items.title: Harvest a Prickeye
items.detail: Fast travel to Tycoon Lake in Burning Springs and harvest orange bulbs, or plant in C.A.M.P.

items.title: Kill Insects
items.detail: Visit Giant Teapot for bees or Tanagra Town for Cave Crickets in the giant tree cave.

items.title: Kill The Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher
items.detail: Start a Head Hunt at Highway Town; Slasher appears as uninvited guest at event completion.

items.title: Kill a Cultist
items.detail: Fast travel to Point Pleasant for up to 34 Cultists; target heads with V.A.T.S.

items.title: Repair Armor, Weapons, or Power Armor
items.detail: Grab a Protest Sign, hit an enemy to degrade it, then repair with 1 Wood at a workbench.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Acid
items.detail: Craft Bulk Acid at a Tinker's Workbench and scrap it for fastest completion.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Crystal
items.detail: Scrap crystal liquor decanters or floater freezer pus sacs; Clancy Manor has decanters inside.

items.title: Travel on foot (KM)
items.detail: Sprint under encumbrance limit on open ground; route from Vault-Tec to Morgantown works well.

events.name: Gold Rush and Double Mutations
events.description: Double currency rewards and mutated enemies during this bonus event period.

events.name: Mutated Public Events
events.description: Public events feature mutated variants with special rewards in party packages.

events.name: Double XP Weekend
events.description: Experience gain is doubled, enabling faster leveling and scoreboard progression.

events.name: World Pets Update (Patch 72) / Season 27
events.description: Major update introducing world pets and beginning of Season 27.

events.name: Treasure Hunter and Double Mutations
events.description: Treasure Hunter event returns with mutated variants and special loot.

events.name: Holiday Scorched
events.description: Holiday-themed scorched enemies spawn with festive rewards and waterlogged gifts.
